basis: The population is every shipped source family: the six root modules plus scripts/resolve-repo-pins.py, scripts/ci/compare_durations.py, scripts/ci/coverage_ratchet.py and the three scripts/bench/ files, because all six scripts run in these workflows, so measuring only the renderers reported coverage for a smaller program than the one that ships. The floor sits one tenth of a point under this box's 73.5% because the ubuntu-latest/3.13 cell has measured three lines differently on impact_loc.py (70 missed there against 67 here), which moves this 2556-statement ratio by 0.117 points to 73.4 — so the runner passes on the first push and the first automatic raise then pins the floor to that cell's own reading. `raise` refuses outright when the measured file count differs from the `files` recorded here, because a percentage cannot announce that its own denominator changed; a same-population coverage change still moves the number without moving that count, and only a person re-deriving it catches that.
